sources.title: OCI Architecture Center
sources.fallback_text: OCI Architecture Center provides reference architectures and solution patterns for designing workloads on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Use it to compare service choices, understand common deployment topologies, and identify design considerations for availability, networking, security, and operations.

sources.title: OCI Well-Architected Framework
sources.fallback_text: OCI Well-Architected Framework organizes architecture review around reliability, security, performance efficiency, operational excellence, and cost optimization. Architecture recommendations should call out assumptions, risks, and tradeoffs across these pillars.

sources.title: OCI Virtual Cloud Network Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Virtual Cloud Networks provide isolated, configurable networks for cloud resources. VCN design should define CIDR ranges, subnets, route tables, security lists or network security groups, gateways, and private connectivity patterns.

sources.title: OCI Load Balancer Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Load Balancer distributes traffic to backend resources and supports highly available application entry points. Designs should consider public versus private load balancers, backend health checks, listener configuration, TLS termination, and fault-domain placement.

sources.title: OCI Object Storage Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Object Storage stores durable unstructured data such as static website assets, product media, logs, backups, and artifacts. Architecture recommendations should consider buckets, lifecycle policies, retention, access controls, encryption, replication needs, and cost tradeoffs for static and archival content.

sources.title: OCI CDN Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI CDN and edge services help deliver static content closer to users and can reduce origin load for web and ecommerce workloads. Designs should evaluate cacheable assets, TLS, origin protection, traffic routing, performance goals, availability requirements, and security controls such as WAF where appropriate.

sources.title: OCI Compute Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Compute provides virtual machines, bare metal instances, images, shapes, and autoscaling options for application workloads. Architecture reviews should connect compute choices to availability, scaling, performance, patching, and operational requirements.

sources.title: OCI Database Services Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI database services include managed Oracle Database options and supporting capabilities for resilient data tiers. Architecture recommendations should clarify data durability, backup, recovery, high availability, Data Guard-style protection where appropriate, connectivity, and operational ownership.

sources.title: OCI Kubernetes Engine Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Kubernetes Engine, also known as OKE, runs managed Kubernetes clusters on OCI. Migration from EKS should assess Kubernetes versions, ingress controllers, worker node pools, persistent volumes, container registry, IAM mappings, secrets, networking, observability, and rollout strategy.

sources.title: OCI Database Migration Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Database Migration supports database migration planning and execution. Migration from RDS to OCI should discover the source engine, version, extensions, data size, downtime tolerance, replication needs, validation approach, and target service such as Base Database Service, Autonomous Database, MySQL HeatWave, or another managed database option.

sources.title: OCI Full Stack Disaster Recovery Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI disaster recovery design should define RTO and RPO targets, application criticality tiers, cross-region topology, database replication, Data Guard-style database protection where appropriate, backups, DNS or traffic failover, runbooks, monitoring, security controls, and regular DR drills. Fintech DR designs also need auditability, key management, and evidence of tested recovery.

sources.title: OCI Cost Management Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI cost optimization should use budgets, cost analysis, tagging, right-sized compute, autoscaling, storage tiering, lifecycle policies, environment shutdown schedules, and measured utilization. Cost reviews should preserve required availability, backup, security, and monitoring controls.

sources.title: OCI Security Services Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI security architecture should cover IAM, least privilege, compartment strategy, network security groups, private subnets, encryption, Vault for keys and secrets, Cloud Guard, Security Zones, logging, audit, monitoring, and compliance evidence.

sources.title: OCI Identity and Access Management Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Identity and Access Management provides identity domains, users, groups, dynamic groups, policies, federation, and authentication controls. Architecture guidance should define compartment strategy, least privilege policies, workload identities, administrator access, break-glass access, and audit expectations.

sources.title: OCI Network Security Groups Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Network Security Groups provide virtual firewall rules for selected VNICs. Designs should use NSGs to express application-tier and data-tier traffic policy, reduce broad subnet-level exposure, and support auditable east-west and ingress controls.

sources.title: OCI Autonomous Database Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Autonomous Database is a managed Oracle Database service with automated operations. Architecture and migration guidance should evaluate workload type, connectivity, private endpoints, backup and recovery needs, performance, data movement, compatibility, and operational ownership.

sources.title: OCI Vault Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Vault provides key management and secrets capabilities. Enterprise designs should use Vault for customer-managed keys, secret storage, rotation planning, encryption governance, backup and DR access, and separation of duties for sensitive application configuration.

sources.title: OCI Logging Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Logging collects and manages service, custom, and audit-related logs. Architecture recommendations should include centralized logging, retention, log groups, operational troubleshooting, security investigation, and integration with monitoring or downstream analysis.

sources.title: OCI Monitoring Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Monitoring provides metrics, alarms, and notifications for cloud resources and applications. Designs should define health signals, alarms, notification topics, SLO indicators, capacity trends, cost signals, and incident response expectations.

sources.title: OCI Cloud Guard Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Cloud Guard helps detect and respond to security posture problems. Security architecture guidance should consider detector recipes, responder recipes, monitored compartments, posture findings, operations ownership, and integration with incident response.

sources.title: OCI Web Application Firewall Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Web Application Firewall protects web applications at the edge. Internet-facing architectures should evaluate WAF policies, origin protection, TLS, bot and threat controls, CDN integration, logging, and operational tuning for application security.
